View 1.summary: Shipping drugs from manufacturer status to wholesaler status constitutes a sale because it is a transaction between entities with separate statuses.

View 2.summary: Internal transfer within the same company does not constitute a sale because sale presupposes a transaction with an independent third party.

c1.text: Company P holds licenses for both drug manufacturing and drug sales, simultaneously holding the status of both a drug manufacturer and a drug wholesaler.

c2.text: Company P shipped drugs under its manufacturer status and received them under its wholesaler status.

c3.text: Article 2 is intended to strictly manage and prevent the abnormal distribution of drugs.

c4.text: Moving drugs from the manufacturer side to the wholesaler side can be regarded as a transaction between entities with separate statuses.

c5.text: Company P shipping drugs from its manufacturer status and receiving them as a wholesaler constitutes a 'sale' under the regulations.

c6.text: 'Sale' generally means transferring goods to another person in exchange for a price, presupposing a giver and a recipient.

c7.text: Receiving and managing drugs within the same company is merely an internal transfer and not a transaction with an independent third party.

c8.text: Company P shipping drugs from its manufacturer status and receiving them as a wholesaler does not constitute a 'sale' under the regulations.

h1.text: A person intending to be a drug wholesaler must obtain permission from local heads, while a manufacturer must obtain permission from the FDA head.

h2.text: The statuses of drug manufacturer and drug wholesaler are separate and independent.

a.note: Separate licensing authorities support rather than undermine separate statuses, so View 1 is not weakened.

h3.text: The concept of 'delivery' included in 'sale' under Article 1 encompasses the transfer of a thing itself irrespective of the transaction counterparty.

b.note: If delivery irrespective of counterparty constitutes a sale, the internal transfer qualifies as a sale, which supports View 1 and opposes View 2.

h5.text: According to the purpose of Article 2, the concept of sale means distribution of drugs to the general public.

h6.text: Company P's internal shipment and receipt of drugs is not distribution of drugs to the general public.

c.note: If sale requires distribution to the general public, internal transfer between manufacturer and wholesaler is not a sale, providing a direct argument for View 2.
